scenarios.title: New enrollment uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date regardless of Assessment Date
Current eligibility uses Assessment Date when Assessment Date changes and relevant fields are unchanged
Assessment Date change takes precedence when Assessment Date and relevant fields change together
Future eligibility with unchanged Assessment Date uses Eligibility Date when relevant fields change

gaps: TC_002 is most closely related, but scenario description condition is missing from the table: "2) Assessment Tier changes while the Assessment Date is unchanged." scenarios.title: Eligibility Date versus Maintenance Date boundary resolves correctly when Assessment Date is unchanged
gaps: TC_002 is the most closely related case, but scenario description also requires "2) The Maintenance Date is exactly equal to the Eligibility Date, so the boundary outcome is resolved consistently with the story’s prior-to-versus-after split. 3) The change is received after the Eligibility Date, so the winning date is the Maintenance Date." and the named grouping "Pregnancy Indicator + Rate Cell" from SEGMENT GLOSSARY is not covered by any test case; add a dedicated test case for it

scenarios.title: Capitation and finance outcomes remain aligned after transaction effective date logic change
Winning-date source missing or unusable is handled without using an unsupported fallback date
File naming and file type route E and U transactions to the correct date-selection rule family

Step 9 Step Description quotes "open database file OH-Facets-crt_69.pzb from C:\Caresource\Trizetto\PZB_Files" while TC_003 Step 13 Step Description quotes "load AR-Facets-crt_69.pzb"; the batch uses conflicting Facets database file names for the same AR PASSE scenario.

Step 13 Step Description quotes "load AR-Facets-crt_69.pzb" while TC_001 Step 20 Step Description quotes "enter the product file name OH-Facets-crt_69.pzb" and TC_002 Step 9 Step Description quotes "open database file OH-Facets-crt_69.pzb"; the batch uses conflicting Facets database file names for the same AR PASSE scenario.
